pagehead.headingMain: The capability is real. So is the risk.
pagehead.headingSub: We exist to hold the second part down.
pagehead.lead: For ecommerce brands developing an entirely new product, and for established brands expanding a portfolio that already sells, China remains the deepest manufacturing base in the world for tooling speed, component sourcing, and factory capacity, across categories from injection molded plastics to precision electronics assembly. That's exactly why the horror stories exist alongside it. The risk was never the country: it's going in without vetting, without contracts, and without inspection standards, and finding out too late.

riskControl.heading: Every failure mode has a control. We run all of them.
riskControl.note: Already picturing a specific worst case? Pick it, and we'll jump straight to the answer.
riskControl._skipped: The 5 risk/control rows and their IP-stack/dossier/AQL-report detail panels are intentionally left out of the CMS — they're tightly interleaved with interactive JS (worst-case picker data-target wiring, expand/collapse toggles, inline term links) that has already been reviewed and hardened multiple times. Edit them directly in custom-plus.html if needed.
